title: Sagan whispers 'keep up the great work' to Hoagland
summary: Maaneli Derakhshani tells of Sagan whispers 'keep up the great work' to Hoagland, about unspecified at a public or congressional hearing, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: apparently came up to him and put his hand on his shoulder and said, "Keep up the great work." Like whispered into his ear and then uh walked off.

plain: Maaneli Derakhshani passes on a story about Richard Hoagland, a man known for claims about strange features on other worlds, and the famous scientist Carl Sagan. According to the story, at a hearing Sagan walked up to Hoagland, put a hand on his shoulder, whispered "Keep up the great work," and walked off. It is told because it would mean Sagan privately encouraged work he did not back in public.
